text: North Vale, June 14 — The Tamsin Reservoir repair cost 48 million, people familiar with the matter said. The figure covers emergency dredging, liner replacement and stabilization work completed after last year’s seepage scare, according to the people. Crews from Bracken Hydrotech began the project in February and finished in late May, two weeks ahead of schedule, they said. The bill was split between the county water board and an insurance payout linked to storm damage, the people said. Officials at the board are expected to release a summary at Thursday’s meeting, though no further breakdown is planned, according to people familiar with the matter.
